versions.changelog: Require Lead number before intake handoff
Require Lead number before estimator flow

Initial release of rolling-suds-customer-quote-intake skill.

- Converts messy Rolling Suds customer or salesperson requests into clean intake summaries.
- Normalizes vague service wording into standard categories (e.g., house wash, driveway cleaning).
- Produces intake summary, estimator-ready handoff, Workiz-friendly note, follow-up questions, and flags for manual review.
- Separates known facts from assumptions and emphasizes missing critical info (especially address).
- Follows concise, factual, and internal-use–friendly output guidelines.
